claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location/usage history; only seller text.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions, delivering...
claims.evidence: No functional test photos (screen on, copy/print sample, specs page) to verify the performance claim.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on / may have faults (common with used copiers; plastic wrapping hides condition).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the machine powering on with the display visible (no error codes) and a successful copy/print of a test page.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs service.

risks.risk: Wrong model or variant (seller text mentions AR-M207, but only the body label is visible; some variants differ by features).
risks.proof: A photo of the full model/serial label (including serial number) and the control panel screen showing the exact model/firmware info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-match comparable (treat as basic B/W copier with uncertain features).

risks.risk: Consumables/toner/drum condition unknown; could be near end-of-life or missing parts.
risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum status (or inside bay if accessible) plus a test print showing image quality (no streaks/blank pages).

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (feed rollers, fuser, jams) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of feeding and printing multiple pages (e.g., 20–30 pages) showing no jams and consistent output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having potential paper-feed/fuser issues.

risks.risk: A3/A4 capability and tray configuration unknown (only partial tray labels visible).
risks.proof: Photo of the paper tray settings and a test print on A3 and A4 (or a screen showing supported sizes).

proof_requests: Video: power on with display visible (no error codes) + successful copy/print of a test page.
Photo of the serial number/model plate clearly (full label) and a shot of the control panel.
Test output photos: first page and 10–20th page to confirm no streaks/jams.
Photo/video showing toner/drum status or inside bay condition (if safe to open).
Confirm supported paper sizes (A4/A3) with a test print on each (if claimed/needed).
response.reason: The model label appears to be SHARP AR-M207, but the photos don’t show any powered-on state or working test results. Without proof it works and prints cleanly, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
